How much does a project cost?
It depends on what you need, so every project gets its own quote. Quotes are free, and you will know the price before anything is booked. Send a few lines through the quote form to get one.
How long does a project take?

Most websites take one to three weeks from kickoff to launch, depending on how much content is ready. Online stores usually take three to five weeks. Larger software is planned in stages, and the quote includes a timeline.
No. We take on any kind of project, including software and IT work: web apps, business systems, integrations, Microsoft 365 and email. Evo, Mailtabs and StudyCat on this site are our own products.
Yes. Larger projects can be split into two payments: half to begin and half at launch. Just mention it when you get in touch.
Every project includes a period of free support. After that you can move to monthly maintenance at any time, or handle updates yourself. We hand over everything you need either way.
Do you work with clients outside Georgia?
Yes. Most of our work happens remotely over email and calls, so location is not a limitation.
What should I send before we talk?
A rough idea of what you need, your timeline, and any sites or apps you like. We will follow up with specific questions.
Yes, no strings attached. We talk through your project and give you a realistic scope and price before anything is booked.

Mailtabs by EvoSoft puts Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP inbox in one place, sorted into tabs you design. Try the live demo with a test account.
Every inbox in one place, in tabs you design.
Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo or any IMAP account and sort all of it into tabs built from accounts and rules. A complete mail client, not just a reader.

Mailtabs is a self-hosted mail client for people with too many inboxes. A tab is a set of accounts plus optional rules, so Work shows only work mail and Receipts collects every order confirmation across every account. Everything you do goes back to the real mailbox, so your phone stays in sync.
Combine accounts and rules like “from contains @company.com” or “subject contains receipt”.

StudyCat by EvoSoft is a study platform with notes, flashcards, endless practice and discussions for university courses. Try the demo with test accounts.
A free study hub for university courses.
Notes, formula sheets, flashcards, endless practice problems, interactive tools and a moderated community for eight Montana State University courses, live at studycat.org.

StudyCat gives every class the same complete toolkit: a dashboard with the next exam, notes with worked examples, spaced-repetition flashcards, a quizzer that generates new problems forever, and exam prep. Students sign in to sync progress across devices, join discussions and use it offline as an installed app.
